mapper.select: SELECT t.terms_id, t.code, t.title, t.version, t.is_required AS required, COALESCE(a.agreed, FALSE) AS agreed, a.agreed_at FROM () t LEFT JOIN user_terms_agreements a ON a.terms_id = t.terms_id AND a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.display_order, t.terms_id
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM () t WHERE t.is_required AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_terms_agreements a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.terms_id = t.terms_id AND a.agreed ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_terms_agreements (user_id, terms_id, agreed, agreed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{termsId}, #{agreed}, CASE WHEN #{agreed} THEN now() END) ON CONFLICT (user_id, terms_id) DO UPDATE SET agreed = EXCLUDED.agreed, agreed_at = CASE WHEN NOT EXCLUDED.agreed THEN NULL WHEN user_terms_agreements.agreed THEN user_terms_agreements.agreed_at ELSE now() END
